metaDescription: Order custom pocketed pencils with your logo. Perfect for trade shows and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom pocketed pencils are designed to hold a small card, note, or photo inside a clear sleeve built into the pencil barrel. This unique feature makes them a functional giveaway for trade shows, conferences, and registration desks where attendees can insert their business card or a personalized message. Unlike standard imprinted pencils, pocketed pencils offer two branding surfaces: the barrel imprint and the insert card. Choose from round or hexagonal shapes in classic #2 graphite or colored leads to match your campaign theme.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed pencils with a clear sleeve holding a business card, displayed on a table at a trade show.
